﻿SEGA - Football Manager 27 - USA/Canada Influencer
TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
✔ You do not need a dedicated page for this campaign. You can post on any page.
⚠️ Audience Requirement: USA and Canada audience to participate.
* Connect your account in Clipping Culture. Audience data is automatic.
* TikTok and YouTube Shorts: only USA and Canada views are paid.
* Instagram: pay is based on your page's audience, not the post.
  WHAT TO DO
Clip moments from the Football Manager 27 creator videos. Post to TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
Content folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XCvBQqY3vIzg5s9kEmOmw20cIJNCD3jT?usp=sharing
	

⚠️ Use only the creator videos from the content folder. Outside footage is rejected.
	  CAPTION GUIDELINES (REQUIRED)
MUST INCLUDE
✔ Tag @footballmanager (same handle on every platform)
✔ Caption written in English
✔ Disclosure hashtag (see FTC DISCLOSURE below)
✔ Tag the creator whose video you clipped (see CREATOR TAGS below)
YOUR CHOICE
* Everything else is up to you. Write your own caption around the required parts.
* Make the caption match the clip.
EXAMPLES
* A closer look at Football Manager 27. @footballmanager
#Ad
* Matchday in FM27. Which club are you managing first? @footballmanager
#Ad
* Watching the Football Manager 27 launch trailer again. @footballmanager
#Ad
NOTE
   * Keep it genuine. Write what a real fan would say.
   * Keep it true. No made-up facts, stats, or dates.
   * Write your own. Do not copy other clippers' captions.
  FTC DISCLOSURE (REQUIRED)
Every post MUST include one of these in the caption:
#Ad     #Advertisement     #Sponsored
	   * Put it on its own line, right after the caption text.
   * It must be the first hashtag.
   * Up to 3 more related hashtags are allowed.
  LOGO WATERMARK (REQUIRED)
Add the Football Manager logo to every clip.
Logo files: https://brand.footballmanager.com/core-logos
	  CREATOR TAGS (REQUIRED)
Tag the creator you clipped, using their handle for your platform.
CREATOR (FOLDER)
	INSTAGRAM
	TIKTOK
	YOUTUBE SHORTS
	KACCE ANDERSON
	@chi_kacee
	@chi_kacee
	@chi_kacee
	NICKRTFM
	@nickrtfm
	@nickrtfm
	@NickRTFM
	  ON-SCREEN TEXT (REQUIRED)
✔ English on-screen text on every post
Same rule as captions. Keep it genuine and true.
  EDITING GUIDELINES
Background music: NOT ALLOWED. Use only the audio from the creator videos.
No AI voices. No AI voiceovers, AI narration, or AI-cloned voices.
  REQUIREMENTS
POST SPECS
✔ High-quality posts only. No blurry or low-effort content.
✔ Video must be at least 10 seconds long
✔ Post must stay live for 30 days minimum
PERFORMANCE
✔ Minimum 0.20% engagement rate (1,000 views = at least 2 likes)
✔ Likes must be visible. Hidden likes = automatic rejection.
✔ Only USA and Canada views are paid
✔ By participating you agree to make your post FTC compliant
  NOT ALLOWED
CONTENT
❌ Footage not from the content folder
❌ Not tagging the creator you clipped
❌ Low-quality or lazy uploads
❌ NSFW, violent, or controversial content
❌ Racist, homophobic, or sexual content = instant ban
❌ Reposting another creator's video as your own
❌ Exaggerated hooks, rage bait, or hate bait
❌ False or made-up claims, stats, or dates
❌ Mislabeling the content (a trailer is not "gameplay")
❌ Any added music
❌ AI voiceovers or AI-generated voices
ENGAGEMENT FRAUD
❌ Bait posting: unrelated viral content to farm views
❌ Spam posting: the same video on multiple accounts
❌ Story boosting: story views do not count
❌ Paid promotion or ads of any kind = permanent ban
❌ Posting the same video more than 5 times
POST VIOLATIONS
❌ Removing the post before 30 days
❌ Hidden likes
Questions? Contact the Clipping Culture team, not the client.
